method: closing critic:monsters, fighter-review method. Sheet: node art/tools/three_snapshot.mjs art/out/units/<id>.glb --unit (before: _harness/_shots/fw_CW4_m_before_<id>.png; after: art/renders/units/<id>.png). In game: node _harness/value_probe.mjs --maps rift --tiers high --monsters only --t 370|70 (RIFT, 1920x1080, 28.5 m, fog off, the camps forced visible) -> _harness/_reports/fw_CW4_monsters.json (tags fw_CW4_mon_before, fw_CW4_mon_after1, fw_CW4_mon_after2, fw_CW4_mon_after1_t70) and shots _harness/_shots/value_rift_high_<tag>_mon_<id>.png. hp = std of display L* minus its 5x5 masked box mean inside the unit's faces (the E1 landmark metric); breakup = p95-p5 of the 0.5 m band (needs >= 0.5 m faces: 0 on small units); dL/dE76 against the floor ring 0.6-2.5 m past the unit's screen box; maxIoU = silhouette IoU (32x32 square-padded screen box) with the most similar other kind.
gate: hp >= the lane's hp (the E1 landmark bar) and breakup >= 6 where the faces allow; |dL*| >= 20 against the camp floor; L* p90 <= 86; no eye pair or face on a stone figure; sensitivity: no tall/pointed hood, no horror mask

before.read: a heap of grey and brown rounded boxes around a flat yellow ball; chalk-grey stone with no value structure; dark iron blocks read as holes

changes: the 9 halo stones and 3 keel stones are Needle splinters (square shaft tapering to a pyramid point outward, the inner end broken) instead of rounded boxes: a sunburst of broken needle-tips
warm honey needle-stone palette (#D2BE98) with noon-lit tops, umber undersides and broad blotches; umber-bronze bands (#5C4431) in place of grey iron
gold-leaf hour-tick inlays in the grooves (glossier), inked shard ridges (edge ink), fresh pale fracture faces
icon re-rendered from the new model
horrorFaceRead: none: no face, no eye pair; the orb is a single light
motion: unchanged clips (idle halo drift, Shard Rain, Noon Glare, Splinter Spray, death scatter) read on the sheet; pieces bind per island, the splinters rest on their actual vertices in death

round2.note: Core is a painted noon dial now (hot cap, burnt limb, umber hour ring, 12 ticks, no hands, no facets because the Style Bible bans gems). hp 2.84-3.27 over the round-2 runs, breakup 11.8-30.4 (the pieces orbit).
